results.snippet: Radialenes are compounds that contain a ring of carbon atoms, each connected to a methylene (CH2) group outside of the ring by a double bond. The smallest radialene, [3]radialene, has a planar structure and unique optical and electrochemical properties.

results.title: Sulfone-functionalized stereoisomeric [3] radialene displays guest...
results.snippet: We present a special class of dynamic framework materials based on a sulfone-functionalized stereoisomeric [3]radialene TTRO. The TTRO synthesis is based on an optimized Fukunaga condensation protocol and involves ecient sulde oxidation.
